newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN JULY BANKRUPTCY DEBT UP 158.1%-RESEARCH FIRM.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN JULY BANKRUPTCY DEBT UP 158.1%-RESEARCH FIRM.

text.p: Total debts at bankrupt Japanese companies in July rose 158.1 percent from the same month last year to 1.13 trillion yen, a record for the month, a private research company said on Thursday.
The number of bankruptcies in July rose 5.0 percent from a year earlier to 1,301, Tokyo Shoko Research said.
Bankruptcy debt has exceeded one trillion yen three times this year on a monthly basis, Tokyo Shoko said in a report.
The debt figure was the highest ever for July, surpassing the previous high of 691.7 billion yen set in July 1992, Tokyo Shoko said.
